scope: standalone pre-product native mechanics exception; no Engine, LabSupervisor, learned policy or physical qualification

boundary_rules.contact: first completed interval with rover_puck_contact true
boundary_rules.dwell: first completed interval with dwell_ticks == 1; no additional command-zero predicate
boundary_rules.paused: synchronous step returned, callback removed, writer flushed; no elapsed simulated time while captured
boundary_rules.continuation: exact four source rows starting at snapshot completed tick; missing trigger/successors fails; no later selection

recording.tick: zero-based action index; state tick is completed intervals
recording.features: exact puck.project float32[8] before one command; virtual privileged-derived sensors
recording.cameras: actual pre-action returned cam_left/cam_right uint8[128,128,3], not controller inputs
recording.contacts: all ten .002s pre-integration packets plus cached last packet, using unmodified ContactProbe classes; separate puck summary
recording.task: pure puck cursor and reward, separate upstream navigation diagnostics; task_sha256 binds state/world/contact/teacher_mode_after
recording.comparison: exact schema/dtype/shape/bytes for all recorded arrays and application hashes; all numeric values finite; no cross-owner raw allocation-byte equality claim

teacher_mode.events: episode_start teacher_mode; every puck_interval teacher_mode_before/teacher_mode_after; final result/record summary retain mode
teacher_mode.semantics: before=caller mode before exactly one decision; after=returned mode committed with completed control interval; not inferred from the resulting world

snapshot: Generic native snapshot with verifier application version2 retaining explicit teacher_mode; validate case-specific mode, initial approach, version, gate/task hashes and application digest BEFORE native restore. Fixed command roots/action replay retain fixed mode. No mode reset on continuation or policy replay; production snapshot format unchanged.

watchdog.identity: discover new direct child by exact script/--child argv and new session PID=PGID before receipt; bind every atomic receipt to PID/start/owner and monotonically completed ticks
watchdog.forced_cleanup: any watchdog signal or receipt/identity error fails gate; bounded_process retains final supervision and group cleanup
watchdog.limits: at most128 observed descendants; late or missing final PID/group absence fails

version_notes.change: Explicit two-mode teacher recovery; existing numeric thresholds, physics, task objectives, layouts, fixed commands and resource ceilings unchanged. Numeric record schema and standalone application are version2; v1/v2 protocol snapshots are rejected before restore.
version_notes.construction_compatibility: XML and native constructor unchanged except protocol identity; construction evidence remains historical, not automatic v3 qualification. Each fresh owner still validates and constructs the fixed model.
version_notes.development_status: Same inspected development scenes. No success, unseen, learned or held-out claim. Learning remains closed pending review of mode-dependent labels for the prior stateless student.
